notes: Open, removed, or pulled-out is treated as the on state; closed or reseated is treated as off. The initial camera survey and bathroom traversal were not counted. Each independently moving leaf of the two double-door upper cupboards is reported separately; their closely spaced transitions have lower confidence.
scene_description: A user moves through a compact kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry, four upper-cupboard leaves, two cooker lids, and an air-fryer drawer.
